command.name: daily-command-center-builder
command.command: codex exec --full-auto 'Implement only Phase A from docs/reverse-engineering/dailyhub-daily-command-center.md. Build an independently authored dependency-light daily-command-center/v1 domain module plus deterministic Node tests. The module must derive a pure daily projection from canonical Project Desk / Work Queue style facts, emit explainable nudge reason codes, implement exact-revision bounded focus receipts with expiry/stale-target invalidation, keep task completion claims distinct from verifier/release/shipped truth, and produce deterministic analytics/output digests independent of input ordering. Do not create a second Project/Task database, copy DailyHub source/UI/assets/schema/tests, add network access, MCP expansion, UI, persistence migration, Git mutation, deployment or provider writes. Preserve existing behavior and run the narrowest focused tests before returning.'

repairCommand.name: daily-command-center-repair
repairCommand.command: codex exec --full-auto 'Read $SHIPPING_CONTEXT_FILE and $SHIPPING_FAILURE_FILE plus docs/reverse-engineering/dailyhub-daily-command-center.md. Repair only the failing Phase A Daily Command Center gate. Preserve projection purity, exact-revision focus semantics, explainable nudges and completion-vs-verification-vs-shipping separation. Do not broaden scope, use network, copy donor implementation, create a second work database, push, merge or deploy. Run the narrowest relevant tests.'

goldenPath.description: The same canonical work facts produce the same daily projection and digest regardless of input ordering.
Overdue, blocked, human-decision, agent-input, failed-verification and production-gap facts produce explicit stable nudge reason codes.
A valid bounded focus receipt emphasizes its exact target revision without suppressing required human, verification or production attention.
Expired focus and focus bound to a changed, superseded or missing target revision are rejected or omitted rather than silently applied.
Focus changes presentation only and cannot mutate priority, approval, verification, authorization or shipping truth.
Actor completion, completion report, verified completion, deployed release, production verification and portfolio shipped states remain distinct in the projection.
Project-grouped daily work and deterministic analytics are derived from canonical facts without creating or mutating a second task/project store.
Unknown or malformed required source facts fail closed or surface unknown state instead of fabricating urgency, completion or release truth.
Projection and focus receipts contain bounded identifiers/digests/reason codes and do not embed secrets or unrelated private context.

excludedFromRelease: DailyHub source, schema, tests, branding, copy or UI asset reuse
SQLite migration or new persistence authority
